skill.summary: AI tool that creates viral fitness recipe videos with AI-generated images, voiceovers, renders, and optional TikTok auto-posting.

latestVersion.changelog:
Fitness Recipes AI 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches an AI-powered tool to create viral fitness recipe videos for TikTok.
- Automates image generation (fal.ai), voiceover (ElevenLabs), video rendering (Shotstack), and TikTok posting (Postiz or manual export).
- Supports batch and single-video creation workflows.
- Includes configuration options for voice, quality, and output location.
- Documents setup requirements, API keys, and estimated per-video costs.
